{"title": "Build retirement income plan", "templateId": "b413f724-2319-5621-8e38-9828f9b07b41", "text": "Create a retirement income plan that converts Evelyn Lanternmoss's goals, available resources, expected income sources, tax considerations, and portfolio constraints into a sustainable withdrawal and cash-flow strategy. Document assumptions, identify planning gaps, and prepare recommendations for advisor review. {"title": "Gather retirement income inputs", "text": "Collect current spending targets, anticipated retirement timing, pension or Social Security estimates, account types, cash reserves, recurring liabilities, and known major upcoming expenses. {"title": "Model withdrawal and tax sequencing", "text": "Compare withdrawal order options across taxable, tax-deferred, and tax-free accounts. {"title": "Stress-test plan assumptions", "text": "Evaluate the plan under lower return, higher inflation, longer longevity, and unexpected expense scenarios. Flag assumptions that materially change the recommendation.", "priority": "medium", "assigneeId": null, "dueDate": null},
